ATH_XMCD

Source file: Analysis/ATH_XMCD.ipf

XMCD/XMLD calculations for 2D images and 3D stacks.

This module provides helper routines for computing normalized contrast maps of the form (w1 - w2) / (w1 + w2) for individual images, two-layer stacks, all pairwise layer combinations, and specific four-layer acquisition schemes. It also includes a multithreaded worker-based implementation for stack combinations.

CalculateXMCDWAVE

Signature

CalculateXMCDWAVE(WAVE w1, WAVE w2, [string outWave, WAVE wRef])

Compute a normalized XMCD/XMLD image from two input waves.

Calculates (w1 - w2) / (w1 + w2) after converting integer inputs to single precision if needed. The result is written either to a named output wave or to a provided destination wave reference.

Parameters

  • w1 (Wave): First input image.

  • w2 (Wave): Second input image.

  • outWave (String, optional): Optional output-wave name. Exactly one of outWave or wRef must be provided.

  • wRef (Wave, optional): Optional destination wave reference. Exactly one of outWave or wRef must be provided.

Returns

  • Wave: Reference to the output wave. Returns a null wave reference on invalid argument usage.

CalculateXMCD

Signature

CalculateXMCD(WAVE w1, WAVE w2)

Compute a normalized XMCD/XMLD image and save it in the current data folder.

Validates that the two waves have equal dimensions, computes (w1 - w2) / (w1 + w2), copies scales from w1, and attaches provenance notes.

Parameters

  • w1 (Wave): First input image.

  • w2 (Wave): Second input image.

Returns

  • Variable: Returns 0 on success and -1 if the dimensions do not match.

StackToXMCD

Signature

StackToXMCD(WAVE w3d, [string wnameStr])

Compute XMCD/XMLD from a two-layer stack.

Extracts the first two layers of w3d and computes (w0 - w1) / (w0 + w1). The output is written to wXMCD or to a user-specified wave name.

Parameters

  • w3d (Wave): Input 3D wave with exactly two layers.

  • wnameStr (String, optional): Optional output-wave name.

Returns

  • Variable: Returns 0 on success and 1 if the stack does not have exactly two layers.

CalculateXMCD3D

Signature

CalculateXMCD3D(WAVE w3d1, WAVE w3d2)

Compute XMCD/XMLD layer by layer for two 3D stacks.

Computes (w3d1 - w3d2) / (w3d1 + w3d2) for all corresponding layers in two equally sized 3D waves. Multithreaded MatrixOP is used for large stacks.

Parameters

  • w3d1 (Wave): First input 3D stack.

  • w3d2 (Wave): Second input 3D stack.

Returns

  • Variable: Returns 0 on success and -1 if the input dimensions are incompatible.

CalculateXMCDComb

Signature

CalculateXMCDComb(WAVE w3d)

Compute XMCD/XMLD for all pairwise layer combinations in a 3D stack.

Iterates over all unique layer pairs in w3d, computes a normalized contrast map for each pair, and stacks the results into a new output wave.

Parameters

  • w3d (Wave): Input 3D stack.

Returns

  • Variable: Returns 0 on success and -1 if w3d is not three-dimensional.

Note

The output stack is saved in the current data folder under a generated name based on XMCD_Comb.

CalculateXMCDDomino

Signature

CalculateXMCDDomino(WAVE w3d)

Compute XMCD/XMLD for all consecutive layers

Iterates over all unique layer pairs in w3d, computes a normalized contrast map for each pair, and stacks the results into a new output wave.

Parameters

  • w3d (Wave): Input 3D stack.

Returns

  • Variable: Returns 0 on success and -1 if w3d is not three-dimensional.

Note

The output stack is saved in the current data folder under a generated name based on XMCD_Domn.

XMCDStack4L

Signature

XMCDStack4L(WAVE wRef, [string order, int overwrite, string outWave])

Compute a difference of two XMCD images from a four-layer stack.

Forms XMCD for layer pairs (l0,l1) and (l2,l3) according to order, then subtracts the second XMCD image from the first. The result is written to outWave.

Parameters

  • wRef (Wave): Input 3D stack with four layers.

  • order (String, optional): Optional permutation string specifying layer order, default 0123.

  • overwrite (Integer, optional): Optional flag controlling whether an existing output wave may be overwritten.

  • outWave (String, optional): Optional output-wave name.

Returns

  • Variable: Returns 0 on success and -1 on invalid input or output creation failure.

MultiThreadXMLDComb

Signature

MultiThreadXMLDComb(WAVE w3D)

Multithreaded computation of XMCD/XMLD for all layer combinations.

Builds all unique layer-pair combinations, dispatches the work to XMCDCalculation_Worker, then concatenates the returned free waves into a combined output stack.

Parameters

  • w3D (Wave): Input 3D stack.

Returns

  • Variable: Returns 0 on completion.

Note

The combined output is stored in the source wave’s data folder using a generated XMCD_Comb name.

XMCDCalculation_Worker

Signature

XMCDCalculation_Worker(WAVE w3D, string idxStr)

Thread-safe worker for a single pairwise XMCD/XMLD calculation.

Parses a layer-index pair from idxStr, extracts the corresponding layers from w3D, computes (w0 - w1) / (w0 + w1), and returns the result as a free wave.

Parameters

  • w3D (Wave): Input 3D stack.

  • idxStr (String): Comma-separated layer indices specifying the pair to process.

Returns

  • Wave: Free wave containing the computed XMCD/XMLD image.
